items.markdown:
![Krabi: Travel Guide to a Coastal Paradise](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07262130-1672-0139-0000-00c6fb90d0b2:4)
Krabi is a province and town located `along the spectacular Andaman Sea coastline in southern Thailand` . Situated roughly 650 km south of Bangkok and east of Phuket, it features towering limestone cliffs, lush jungles, and access to popular islands like Phi Phi and Koh Lanta.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krabi) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krabi)[[2]](https://maps.apple.com/place?auid=7244526772881971873)[[3]](https://www.thailandretreats.com/Destination/Krabi)[[4]](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/krabi)

Here are a few more specific details about Krabi's geography:

- **Distance from nearby hubs:** It is located about 170 km east of Phuket (a 3-hour drive or scenic ferry ride) and lies between the neighboring provinces of Phang Nga, Surat Thani, and Trang.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=htGV5XeKOrQ&t=28) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=htGV5XeKOrQ&t=28)
- **Main destinations:** While Krabi Town is the riverside provincial capital, the vast majority of tourists base themselves nearby at **Ao Nang** (the main seaside hub) or **Railay Beach** (famous for its dramatic rock formations accessible only by boat).[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krabi) [[1]](https://thebackpackinghousewife.com/thailand-krabi/)[[2]](https://www.tuljak.com/blog/crappy-in-krabi-how-we-didnt-enjoy-the-thai-paradise)[[3]](https://www.siamrealestate.com/properties/krabi)
- **Accessibility:** You can fly directly into **Krabi International Airport (KBV)** or take a bus/train from Bangkok (which takes roughly 12 hours).[](https://thailandinsider.com/destination/krabi/) [[1]](https://thailandinsider.com/destination/krabi/)

For help planning your journey or finding specific accommodations in the area, you can look up options and routes on the [Tourism Authority of Thailand](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Krabi/344) guide.
